title: DMK functionary, Sub-Registrar among six booked for alleged land fraud in Srirangam
description: The six accused had allegedly committed the crime fully aware that the land belonged to the Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple; four of the accused had claimed that they owned the over 7,000-sq.ft land in Srirangam and used forged documents to transfer it to the name of the DMK functionary
